batch.title: Hiring and onboarding
batch.goal: Complete requisition, application, invitation, offer, onboarding, and worker provisioning with server-controlled lifecycle states.
exitCriteria: Candidate invitation delivery, redemption, expiration, replay prevention, failure visibility, and organization scoping pass.
Accepted candidates provision exactly one worker identity and can continue to workforce assignment.

findings.title: Hiring/onboarding invites never send email (token returned to admin UI only); Resend wired only for contracts
findings.solution: Integrate Resend delivery into invite paths
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Onboarding workflows/advance accepts arbitrary new_stage without ordering guard or employer scoping
findings.solution: Validate stage transitions; requireAdminCapability per employer
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Job-posting lifecycle status is client-controlled
findings.solution: Remove arbitrary lifecycle status from create/update payloads; expose validated server transition commands with capability, tenant, idempotency, and audit enforcement.
acceptanceCriteria: Forged lifecycle status is rejected; valid transitions follow the state graph and are visible to Admin and candidates.
verificationRequirements: Unit, API, tamper, cross-organization, replay, and recipient tests.

specTasks.title: Standardize requisition workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Draft/approval/open/paused/closed states; tour/event/role/dates/headcount/rate/skills/travel and owner are required as configured.

specTasks.title: Harden application pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Stage transitions, notes, interview tasks, decision reasons, consent/retention, duplicate applicant handling, and role-aware exports are complete.

specTasks.title: Build offer/engagement handoff
acceptanceCriteria: Approved candidate creates contract/offer and contingent assignment; failed/declined/expired outcomes reconcile headcount.

specTasks.title: Version onboarding templates
acceptanceCriteria: Organization owns task/document/acknowledgement templates by role/employment type; changes do not mutate active onboarding.

specTasks.title: Track onboarding dependencies
acceptanceCriteria: Identity/account invite, documents, credentials, policy, payment/payroll handoff, emergency/travel profile, and equipment issuance have owners/due/status.

specTasks.title: Convert without duplicate identity
acceptanceCriteria: Completion activates organization person/tour role/Work Mode access in one idempotent workflow; rollback/retry cannot duplicate rows.

workflows.title: Hiring, Candidate Invitation, and Onboarding

producer.outcome: Publishes a posting, reviews an application, and issues an offer or onboarding invite.

recipients.outcome: Receives, redeems, and completes the employer-scoped invitation.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: The server owns lifecycle transitions and employer scope; tokens are hashed, expiring, single-use, and replay safe.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: The candidate receives a usable invitation and the Admin sees delivery and onboarding state.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.title: Admin to Worker journey passes
launchGates.acceptance: Posting through check-in and recipient acknowledgement passes without soft assertions.
